WatchFileEntry.description: WatchFileEntry is one watch: when the registry gains a tag of ImageRepo matching TagPattern, Service in Space on Node rolls to it.

image_repo.description: ImageRepo is the image repository without a tag, e.g. rg.fr-par.scw.cloud/ns/app.

name.description: Name identifies the watch within the stack; unique across the repos feeding it.

node.description: Node names the registered node, the same form deploy-root.yaml uses.

node_id.description: NodeID is the superseded way to name the node, still read for files already committed.

registry_user.description:
RegistryUser is the user of a private registry; its password is set on the
stack, never in this file.

service.description: Service is the deploy.yaml service (or job) whose image rolls.

space.description: Space is the space on the node that runs Service.

tag_pattern.description:
TagPattern is the regexp a tag must match to roll; empty means the publish
tag format YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<sha>.

description: Schema for .sklp/image-watches.yaml: the images a node rolls when the registry gains a matching tag, generated from domain.WatchFile.
title: sklp image-watches
